rationale: R1 (#736 rust wave): the analyzer emitted NO bare-identifier edges at all while the oracle audited only calls/member reads. Every bare identifier naming a file-visible VALUE is now a Uses edge: file consts/statics (LIMIT/GLOBAL), callbacks as values (identity/target), same-module consts (C in get_c), qualified variant leaves (Color::Red in matcher patterns — the deliberate Rust difference from CPP), call arguments (LIMIT in takes_cb). Shadowing suppresses (param GLOBAL in shadowed). R8: the `where T: Clone` bound emits no references (verified by empty REFS alongside the relationship-kinds String:PartialEq pin, which is a real path bound and still emits).
